watches.provenance: Second owner. Bought from the original owner in Westchester with the 2003 warranty papers.
watches.description: The last of the classic aluminium-bezel Submariner Dates, and for many collectors the purest. The 16610 ran from 1988 to 2010 with the cal. 3135, a sapphire crystal and the slimmer case that later ceramic models gave up. This one wears its twenty years honestly: a clean dial and hands, a bezel insert without fade, and a case that has seen one careful polish.

It is a confident watch that still reads as a tool diver, and the 16613 generation keeps the lighter case and aluminium insert that many prefer to the later ceramic 116613.

watches.description: The Zenith-powered Daytona in solid yellow gold. Rolex modified the El Primero calibre heavily, dropping its beat rate for longevity, and the 16528 is the gold expression of the most collected Daytona generation. Heavy on the wrist, warm in colour, and increasingly hard to find unpolished.
